kultivator.reruntuhan.gua.source: Source: Investiture of the Gods: the Ten Absolute Formations and the Nine Bends of the Yellow River Formation are broken one by one; Romance of the Three Kingdoms ch. 84: Lu Xun loses his way in Zhuge Liang's Stone Sentinel Maze. Inspired by the cave inheritance of the Flower Wine Monk in Reverend Insanity. The puzzles, guardians and rewards are game design.
kultivator.reruntuhan.penjara.source: Source: Water Margin ch. 1: Marshal Hong Xin forces open the Hall of Subdued Demons and its sealed well, freeing the hundred and eight demon stars; Journey to the West ch. 7 and 14: Sun Wukong is imprisoned under the Five Elements Mountain by the Buddha's seal talisman and freed when Tang Sanzang peels it off. Inspired by Meng Hao's Demon Sealer lineage in I Shall Seal the Heavens. Seal strength, demon kings and numbers are game design.
kultivator.reruntuhan.penjara.xiangliu.s: Source: Classic of Mountains and Seas sections 8 and 17: Xiangliu, the nine-headed minister of Gonggong.
kultivator.reruntuhan.penjara.banteng.so: Source: Journey to the West ch. 59-61, the Bull Demon King.
kultivator.reruntuhan.penjara.chiyou.sou: Source: Classic of Mountains and Seas section 17: Chiyou makes war on the Yellow Emperor.
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.source: Source: Dao De Jing ch. 64: a terrace of nine storeys begins with a heap of earth. Inspired by the Heaven Burning Qi Refining Tower of Canaan Academy in Battle Through the Heavens, whose trials grow heavier the deeper its floors. The hundred floors, trials and rewards are game design.
item.kultivator.sobekan_segel.tooltip: A shred of a sealing talisman from the Seal Shrine of an Ancient Demon Prison, still warm with sealing power. Every shred is one talisman pulled. At the Seal Heart, one shred stands in for two blank talismans when you Strengthen the Seal.
item.kultivator.sobekan_segel.source: Source: Water Margin ch. 1: Marshal Hong Xin tears the seals of the Hall of Subdued Demons and opens its well.
item.kultivator.inti_iblis_kuno.tooltip: The core of a demon king slain in an Ancient Demon Prison. The offering of the wolf line's evolution to tier 5 (Spirit Beasts).
item.kultivator.inti_iblis_kuno.inspired: Inspired by the demon cores of xianxia; the material and its use are game design.
item.kultivator.kitab_formasi_kuno.toolt: A formation inheritance from an Ancient Ancestral Cave. Right-click to read the next page (four pages).
item.kultivator.kitab_formasi_kuno.sourc: Source: Romance of the Three Kingdoms ch. 84 (the Stone Sentinel Maze) and Investiture of the Gods (the Ten Absolute Formations, the Nine Bends of the Yellow River).
Stone Sentinels: by the river at Yufu, Zhuge Liang laid heaps of stone into a formation. Lu Xun walked in and its wind, sand and gates kept changing; he only came out led by an old man who knew it. The stones never moved; the heart was what lost its way.

The Ten Absolute Formations: the ten Heavenly Lords of Jin'ao Island raised ten deadly formations against Xiqi, and the Chan disciples broke them one by one. Every formation has a living gate; a formation master looks for that gate, not for a wall to break.

The eight trigrams of the Earlier Heaven: Qian above, Kun below, Li facing Kan, Zhen facing Xun, Gen facing Dui. Opposites complete each other; a formation built from those pairs never leans to one side.

The ancestor's note: wood gives birth to fire, fire to earth, earth to metal, metal to water, water to wood. Whoever reads this has passed my guardian. Carry these formations out of the dark; do not let them die with my bones.

kultivator.screen.help.gua_leluhur.title: Ancestral Caves
kultivator.screen.help.gua_leluhur: Ancestral Caves appear only in new chunks: Lesser Caves in hills and forests (Qi Refining to Foundation), Great Caves in the mountains (Golden Core to Nascent Soul), Ancient Caves in the badlands and the Deep Dark (Deity Transformation to Dao Union). The sealed cliff gate opens when a cultivator of a high enough realm lays a hand on it (click) and channels qi for three seconds. Read the stele in the antechamber, then pass two, three or five formation chambers: Eight Trigrams (step on the plates in the Earlier Heaven order), Five Phases (light the lamps with 5% Qi in the generating cycle, starting from the glyph on the door), Star Map (turn the star-stone rings until each golden star points at the star on the ceiling), Illusion Maze (the Clear Sight Pill shows the false walls, click to dispel them), Heart Mirror (defeat your shadow; it reflects your healing) and Qi Balance (a player weighs 4, a spirit beast 2, a dropped item 1). Each attempt lasts at most three minutes, a hint appears after 90 seconds, and a wrong move only hurts (it never kills). At the end the Stone Guardian rises; once it falls, the ancestor's remnant soul grants the inheritance once per player: spirit stones, aged herbs, beast cores, an Inheritance Jade and, in the highest cave, a second Inheritance Jade and the Ancient Formation Book. Puzzles seal themselves again after some days. Test: /kultivasi uji gua. Every cave looks different: a collapsed gate or a gate pavilion kept by a later sect; stone, library, shrine or garden-grotto chambers; an incense hall or a garden hall. The ancestor's remnant soul greets you by your realm and talks about its life when you stand near it. The guardians' nameplates show their titles and an Enraged mark. Achievements: Heir of the Ancestral Cave, Heir of an Elder Age (Ancient Cave), Surpass Yourself (Heart Mirror).
kultivator.screen.help.penjara_iblis: In the mountains and badlands stands a Seal Shrine: five pillars with seal talismans over a sealed well, and far below it the Hall of Chains with the Seal Heart. The seal's strength (0-100) drops a little every day and one point every hour of a Blood Eclipse. The prison is meant for Dao Union and above: the talismans refuse weaker hands, and the demon king rises only while a Deity Transformation cultivator or stronger is in the hall. Clicking a talisman opens a warning card; holding the seal for 1.5 s pulls it: seal -5 and you receive a Torn Seal, the temptation of Marshal Hong Xin. At the Seal Heart, Strengthen Seal (4 blank talismans + 1 high spirit stone, once a day) raises the seal by 15 and gives Merit and sect renown. One Torn Seal stands in for two blank talismans, and five Merit trade for an Inheritance Jade (sneak and click the Seal Heart). When the seal reaches 0 or all five talismans are pulled, it breaks: the sky turns red, and the demon king (Xiangliu, the Bull Demon King or Chiyou) rises with the sealed demons. Each of its arts is marked on the floor first. Relighting the five pillars (channel qi for three seconds, broken by a hit) weakens its blows by 15% per pillar and seals it again: seal 100, great Merit and a treasure born at the shrine. Slaying it gives the Ancient Demon Core, king cores and a jade slip; the prison then rests for seven days. A demon's lethal blow leaves 1 HP and throws you to the stair (Demon Wound). Test: /kultivasi uji penjara. Prisons in the badlands are built of red sandstone, acacia and mud brick; those in the mountains of blackstone and crimson wood. During a Blood Eclipse the sealed demons grow restless: they range farther, move faster and strike more often. More achievements: Hong Xin's Temptation (pull a talisman) and Sealer under the Red Moon (Reinforce the Seal during a Blood Eclipse). Test: /kultivasi uji penjara cari gurun, /kultivasi uji penjara gerhana true|false.
kultivator.screen.help.menara_seratus: A nine-tier pagoda whose top hides in clouds stands on plains and plateaus. Click its bronze doors: you and up to three companions within 6 blocks enter the lobby of the tower's dimension. Ten band gates take you to the first floor of that band; bands you already passed need not be climbed again. Each band of ten floors follows the same pattern: 1-3 combat waves, 4 a timed formation puzzle, 5 endurance (60 s of formation pulses), 6 combat with an affix, 7 the Trial of the Heart (three Dao riddles, or the mirror shadow), 8 meditation in the circle while qi waves push (sneak to hold on), 9 an elite as strong as a beast king, 10 the band's Floor Guardian. The tower is not the Heavenly Tomb: the tower has a hundred fixed floors for every realm and a weekly ranking, while the Heavenly Tomb is an Immortal Ascension secret realm with endless layers. Disciples wait outside the tower. Floor 100 brings the Shadow of the Self, your own shadow at full strength. Failing sends you to the lobby with Tower Wound (five minutes), without losing items; a lethal blow leaves 1 HP. The first clear of every floor pays spirit stones, every tenth floor a milestone chest, and floor 100 the title Conqueror of the Hundred Floors. The weekly ranking is on the stele; the top three earn sect renown. Test: /kultivasi uji menara. The pagoda has three looks: a white jade tower on the plains, a cherry tower in cherry groves and a mud-brick tower on the savanna, each with a gated forecourt, lotus pools, stone lanterns and guardian lions. Achievements: The First Band, Halfway to Heaven (floor 50), Conqueror of the Hundred Floors. Test: /kultivasi uji menara cari sakura|sabana.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.bagua.riddle: Heaven above, Earth below. Step on the plates of the eight images in Fu Xi's Earlier Heaven order: Heaven, Lake, Fire, Thunder, Wind, Water, Mountain, Earth.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.bagua.hint: Start at ☰ (Heaven, three whole lines) and end at ☷ (Earth, three broken lines): ☰ ☱ ☲ ☳ ☴ ☵ ☶ ☷. The next plate now glows.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.bagua.objecti: Step on the eight trigrams in the Earlier Heaven order
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.unsur.riddle: Wood gives birth to Fire, Fire to Earth, Earth to Metal, Metal to Water, Water to Wood. Light the five lamps with qi in the generating cycle, starting from the phase carved on the door.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.unsur.hint: The glyph on the sealed door is the first phase. Then: 木 → 火 → 土 → 金 → 水 → 木. The next lamp now glows.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.unsur.objecti: Light the lamps from %s, following the generating cycle
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.bintang.riddl: When the Dipper's handle points east, all the world is spring (Heguanzi). Turn the three rings of star stones until each ring's golden star points at the star shining on the ceiling. Every turn also moves the next ring.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.bintang.hint: The inner ring turns the middle one, the middle the outer, the outer the inner. The handle glowing blue is the best next turn. Too many turns overheat the formation's gears.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.ilusi.riddle: The Stone Sentinel Maze led Lu Xun astray with stones that looked like walls (Romance of the Three Kingdoms ch. 84). Some walls here are only shadows of the formation. Find the way to the north door; clear eyes see the false walls.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.ilusi.hint: The Clear Sight Pill shows the false walls to everyone in the room, and a shimmering wall dissolves when clicked. Dead ends hold formation pulses: step away when the red circle shows.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.ilusi.objecti: Find the way through the maze to the north door
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.cermin.riddle: The perfect man uses his heart like a mirror: it sends nothing off, welcomes nothing, answers and keeps nothing (Zhuangzi ch. 7). Your shadow waits behind the mirror; defeat it without leaning on healing.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.cermin.hint: The shadow fights with 60% of your strength. Every heal you take is reflected twice onto it. Dodge the Qi Arrow's line and the Mirror Palm's ring; strike after it dashes.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.cermin.object: Defeat your own shadow without leaning on healing
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.timbangan.rid: Heaven's balance leans to no one. Bring both pans to exactly the weight the stele asks and hold it for three seconds. A cultivator or a disciple weighs 4, a spirit beast 2, one dropped item 1.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.timbangan.hin: Stand on one pan and drop items on the other until both numbers match what is asked; at most eight items per pan count.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.solved: The %s formation is broken. The seal door slides open.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.already: This formation is already broken; it will seal itself again in a few days.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.time_up: Time is up. The formation lashes back and everything returns to the start.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.unsur.no_qi: Not enough Qi to light the lamp (5% Qi).
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.ilusi.reveale: Clear eyes see the false walls shimmer.

kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.cermin.subtit: Your shadow steps out of the mirror
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.cermin.reflec: The mirror reflects your healing onto the shadow: it heals twice as much.
kultivator.reruntuhan.teka.timbangan.ask: The stele asks for a weight of %s on each pan.

kultivator.reruntuhan.gerbang.channel: You channel qi into the seal... hold still.
kultivator.reruntuhan.gua.prasasti.1.tex: "I was only a minor cultivator who closed this cave before my end. Two formations guard my legacy and my stone guardian waits at the end. If you are patient, read every stele; a formation never asks for strength, only for understanding."
kultivator.reruntuhan.gua.prasasti.2.tex: "On this mountain I formed my Golden Core and beheld my Nascent Soul. Three formations weigh your heart; my guardian was forged from mountain tuff. Whoever passes will receive the jade of my Dao."
kultivator.reruntuhan.gua.prasasti.3.tex: "Ages have turned since I raised five formations under this red stone. Many came in, few came out. If you reach my hall, carry my book of formations out of the dark."

kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q0: Water benefits the ten thousand things without contending and dwells where people disdain to be. What is the highest good like?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q0.a1: Like a fire that gives light
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q1: With what does a terrace of nine storeys begin?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q2: With what does a journey of a thousand li begin?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q2.a0: A single step beneath one's feet
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q3: Zhuangzi dreamt he was a butterfly. When he woke, what did he doubt?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q3.a0: Whether he was Zhuangzi dreaming of being a butterfly, or a butterfly dreaming of being Zhuangzi
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q3.a1: Whether his dream foretold the future
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q4: Knowing others is cleverness. What is knowing oneself?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q5: Overcoming others is force. What is overcoming oneself?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q6: The softest thing in the world overcomes the hardest. What does Laozi take as its example?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q6.sr: Source: Dao De Jing ch. 43 and 78
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q6.a0: Water, unequalled at wearing down the hard
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q7: Cook Ding carved oxen for nineteen years without dulling his knife. Why?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q7.a0: He followed the natural gaps between the joints
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q7.a1: His knife was forged of heavenly steel
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q8: A frog at the bottom of a well cannot be told about the sea. Why?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q8.a0: It is confined by its place
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q8.a2: The sea is too salty for it
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q9: When the great Dao is abandoned, what appears?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q10: Those who know do not speak. Those who speak...?
kultivator.reruntuhan.menara.ujian.q11: Before heaven and earth were born, something was formed in chaos. What does Laozi call it?

kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.greet.seni: Hm... a senior visits the cave of an old junior. My legacy is small for you, but my rules still stand.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.greet.peer: Your realm is what mine once was. This cave was made for one like you.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.greet.juni: Child, how did you get in? The outer seal should have turned you away.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.muse.1.0: Once I refined qi on this cliff every dawn. The mountain wind was my first teacher.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.muse.1.1: My foundation cracked twice before it held. Do not be ashamed to fall; be ashamed not to rise.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.muse.1.2: I carved those stone wardens myself. They were more loyal than my disciples.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.muse.2.0: My golden core formed under autumn lightning. I can still smell the scorch of it.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.muse.2.1: My sect vanished in a single night. Only this cave's formations still remember its name.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.muse.2.2: My Nascent Soul once walked to the summit alone while I meditated. It was always braver than I.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.muse.3.0: Once I was one with the Dao for nine days. When I came back, my disciples had grown grey.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.muse.3.1: My last heavenly tribulation came too soon. Do not hurry as I did.
kultivator.reruntuhan.warisan.muse.3.2: The formations of this cave are older than any kingdom below. I was the last to keep them.
